arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the menu supplied compatible combinations rather than requiring me to discover them. Adding mucus was the only gameplay option at step 3.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: following fermentation into the body's exchanges gave the construction a clear purpose, though the choices were fairly constrained.
